subject: Pilot trial runway extension request while connector refactor completes
messages:
From: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@pivotalpay.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot needs runway while connector refactor finishes

Hi Jordan,

Quick context: our payments engineering team started a mid-pilot refactor of the ACH connector last week. The new code path is necessary for our production compliance but it introduced a couple of incompatibilities with the staging adapter we built against your current SDK. We have a short-term workaround but it will add another 3–5 weeks of QA before we can validate the end-to-end flows.

Because of that, we’re asking if Redwood can extend our pilot window by 45 days and increase our sandbox credits by ~30k token-equivalents so we can finish the refactor and run a batch of regression tests. We’d like to avoid pausing the pilot — the team is still getting useful signals — but we need runway to finish the adapter work.

If you need more color I can loop in our eng lead and attach the refactor plan. Appreciate any help you can provide.

—Ethan
Ethan Ross
Senior Product Manager, PivotalPay
ethan.ross@pivotalpay.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@pivotalpay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot needs runway while connector refactor finishes

Hi Ethan — thanks for the heads up and the clear CTA.

We can be flexible here. Initial offer from my side: 30 extra days on the pilot and a 20k sandbox credit top-up. That should cover the bulk of QA for the adapter in most cases. If engineering confirms the refactor is heavier than expected, we can escalate to grants for an additional top-up, or consider a staged extension.

Two quick asks so I can move this through approvals:
- Can you share the refactor timeline (high level) and the list of QA milestones? Even a short doc is fine.
- Is there a hard deadline on your side (regulatory, demo, or funding milestone) that makes 45 days non-negotiable?

I’ve cc’d Laura and Dev so we can get an engineering read on effort and a fast yes/no on the credits. I’ll follow up internally and confirm by end of day tomorrow.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot needs runway while connector refactor finishes — need ETA and cost impact

Folks — forwarding Ethan’s note from PivotalPay. TL;DR: they’re asking for 45 days + 30k credits due to a connector refactor. I’ve proposed 30 days + 20k as an initial accommodation, pending eng assessment.

Laura / Dev — can you give a quick assessment: is 3–5 weeks realistic for their QA window given a typical refactor? Any risk the work will take longer (e.g., cross-team infra changes)? Also, would a 20k credit top-up be reasonable to run end-to-end regression tests, or should we ask for a more detailed runbook from PivotalPay?

Marissa — assuming engineering gives a yes, I’ll need a formal credits approval and the short addendum we attach to the pilot. Do we have an internal template for 30-day extensions + credits? If we can move fast, I’ll offer the 30/20k now and escalate if they push for the full 45/30k.

Appreciate quick replies — I want to close this before the end of the week.

—Jordan
(On behalf of PivotalPay pilot)

Subject: Re: Pilot needs runway while connector refactor finishes — credits/extension approved

Jordan / team —

I reviewed the ask and the current usage on the sandbox for RDW-2026-0917. Approvals: we will grant a 30-day pilot extension starting 2026-12-01 and an initial sandbox credit top-up of 25,000 token-equivalents (to be added to their account by EOD 2026-11-25).

Rationale: 30 days plus 25k should cover the refactor QA in most cases and balances our credits exposure. If PivotalPay demonstrates the additional scope (detailed timeline and a short runbook with milestones), we can revisit another top-up — Marissa will sign off on a second tranche if engineering confirms the need.

Next steps (action items):
- Marissa: upload extension_form.pdf and credits_approval.csv to the deal record and route for signatures. (Done — files attached below.)
- Jordan: send Ethan the formal addendum and include instructions for providing the runbook.
- Laura / Dev: provide a short estimate of any remaining risks by EOD tomorrow so sales ops has the technical justification.

Attachments: extension_form.pdf (signed template), credits_approval.csv (ledger entry)

—Marissa Cole
